subject: Regarding your upcoming flight reservation
body: Dear [Recipient], We hope this email finds you well. We wanted to touch base regarding your upcoming flight reservation for your trip to Paris. Please review the attached itinerary for your flight details and ensure that all the information is correct. If you have any questions or require any assistance, feel free to reach out to our customer support team. We look forward to welcoming you on board and wish you a pleasant journey. Best regards, The Travel Now Team
